work.title: The Life of Timon of Athens
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 3, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. Athens. A room in Lucullus' house
scene.location: Athens. A room in Lucullus' house

content.text: Flaminius waiting to speak with Lucullus from his master.

lines.text: I have told my lord of you; he is coming down to you.
lines.plainText: I have told my lord of you he is coming down to you

lines.text: I thank you, sir.
lines.plainText: I thank you sir

lines.text: Here's my lord.
lines.plainText: Here's my lord

lines.text: [Aside.] One of Lord Timon's men? A gift, I warrant. Why, this hits right. I dreamt of a silver basin and ewer tonight.—Flaminius, honest Flaminius, you are very respectively welcome, sir. Fill me some wine.
lines.plainText: Aside One of Lord Timon's men A gift I warrant Why this hits right I dreamt of a silver basin and ewer tonightFlaminius honest Flaminius you are very respectively welcome sir Fill me some wine

lines.text: His health is well, sir.
lines.plainText: His health is well sir

lines.text: I am right glad that his health is well, sir. And what hast thou there under thy cloak, pretty Flaminius?
lines.plainText: I am right glad that his health is well sir And what hast thou there under thy cloak pretty Flaminius

lines.text: Faith, nothing but an empty box, sir, which in my lord's behalf I come to entreat your honour to supply; who, having great and instant occasion to use fifty talents, hath sent to your lordship to furnish him, nothing doubting your present assistance therein.
lines.plainText: Faith nothing but an empty box sir which in my lord's behalf I come to entreat your honour to supply who having great and instant occasion to use fifty talents hath sent to your lordship to furnish him nothing doubting your present assistance therein

lines.text: La, la, la, la! Nothing doubting, says he? Alas, good lord! A noble gentleman 'tis, if he would not keep so good a house. Many a time and often I ha' dined with him, and told him on't, and come again to supper to him of purpose to have him spend less, and yet he would embrace no counsel, take no warning by my coming. Every man has his fault, and honesty is his. I ha' told him on't, but I could ne'er get him from 't.

lines.text: Please your lordship, here is the wine.
lines.plainText: Please your lordship here is the wine

lines.text: Flaminius, I have noted thee always wise. Here's to thee.
lines.plainText: Flaminius I have noted thee always wise Here's to thee

lines.text: Your lordship speaks your pleasure.
lines.plainText: Your lordship speaks your pleasure

lines.text: I have observed thee always for a towardly prompt spirit, give thee thy due, and one that knows what belongs to reason, and canst use the time well, if the time use thee well. Good parts in thee. [To Servant.] Get you gone, sirrah.—
lines.plainText: I have observed thee always for a towardly prompt spirit give thee thy due and one that knows what belongs to reason and canst use the time well if the time use thee well Good parts in thee To Servant Get you gone sirrah

lines.text: Is't possible the world should so much differ,
lines.plainText: Is't possible the world should so much differ

lines.text: And we alive that lived? Fly, damned baseness,
lines.plainText: And we alive that lived Fly damned baseness

lines.text: To him that worships thee.
lines.plainText: To him that worships thee

lines.text: Ha! Now I see thou art a fool and fit for thy master.
lines.plainText: Ha Now I see thou art a fool and fit for thy master

lines.text: May these add to the number that may scald thee!
lines.plainText: May these add to the number that may scald thee

lines.text: Let molten coin be thy damnation,
lines.plainText: Let molten coin be thy damnation

lines.text: Thou disease of a friend, and not himself!
lines.plainText: Thou disease of a friend and not himself

lines.text: Has friendship such a faint and milky heart
lines.plainText: Has friendship such a faint and milky heart

lines.text: It turns in less than two nights? O you gods,
lines.plainText: It turns in less than two nights O you gods

lines.text: I feel my master's passion. This slave
lines.plainText: I feel my master's passion This slave

lines.text: Unto his honour has my lord's meat in him.
lines.plainText: Unto his honour has my lord's meat in him

lines.text: Why should it thrive and turn to nutriment
lines.plainText: Why should it thrive and turn to nutriment

lines.text: When he is turned to poison?
lines.plainText: When he is turned to poison

lines.text: O, may diseases only work upon't,
lines.plainText: O may diseases only work upon't

lines.text: And when he's sick to death, let not that part of nature
lines.plainText: And when he's sick to death let not that part of nature

lines.text: Which my lord paid for be of any power
lines.plainText: Which my lord paid for be of any power

lines.text: To expel sickness, but prolong his hour.
